records.title: Justice Laws Website: Consolidated Acts
records.scope: Federal Acts and their official consolidations; applicability must still be assessed for the request.

version.currency_note: Publisher presents current and previous versions.

authority.incorporation_basis: Federal enactment or consolidation; specific Act must be selected.

rights.permission_note: Federal law may be reproduced under the Reproduction of Federal Law Order if accuracy is preserved and the copy is not represented as official.

records.applicability_basis: Specific federal instrument and request context required.
exclusions: Does not decide provincial workplace jurisdiction.
records.notes: Store source metadata and a bounded paraphrase; link to the official record for the text.

records.title: Ontario e-Laws
records.scope: Official Ontario statutes and regulations, including current and historical versions.

version.currency_note: Record the currency date shown by e-Laws for the selected instrument.

authority.incorporation_basis: Ontario statute or regulation; select the instrument and version.

rights.permission_note: Follow Ontario terms and preserve source identity; do not treat a web copy as an unqualified legal conclusion.

records.applicability_basis: Ontario location and the specific instrument govern selection.
exclusions: Does not establish federal jurisdiction or another province's rule.
records.notes: Historical versions remain available for as-of analysis; current claims require the current record.

records.title: BC Laws
records.scope: British Columbia statutes and regulations, with official publication caveats and point-in-time needs.

version.currency_note: Confirm the official version and Gazette or amendment record for the activity date.

authority.incorporation_basis: British Columbia enactment or regulation; confirm current official publication status.

rights.permission_note: Use the official source and respect the publisher's reproduction and authority notices.

records.applicability_basis: British Columbia location and selected instrument.
exclusions: A convenient online index is not a substitute for an official publication when the source itself says so.
records.notes: Pending review intentionally prevents a current conclusion until the publisher's currency and authority note are checked.

records.title: Alberta King’s Printer
records.scope: Official Alberta laws, Gazette, Orders in Council, Ministerial Orders, and related materials.

version.currency_note: Check the current consolidation and amendment or proclamation record.

authority.incorporation_basis: Alberta enactment, regulation, Gazette item, order, or proclamation.

rights.permission_note: Alberta identifies the King’s Printer as official and states reproduction restrictions for legislation; retain metadata and link unless authorized.

records.source_date_label: current consolidation, Gazette, or proclamation date
records.applicability_basis: Alberta location and the specific instrument's in-force status.
exclusions: The official OHS search tool is not itself the official version; consult the King’s Printer source for applying law.
records.notes: Rights and authority are separate fields: official status does not grant permission to reproduce protected text.

records.title: LégisQuébec
records.scope: Official Québec compilations and historical versions of statutes and regulations in French and English where available.

version.currency_note: Capture the chapter-specific update date displayed by LégisQuébec.

authority.incorporation_basis: Québec statute or regulation and its official compilation.

rights.permission_note: Preserve the official publisher, language, chapter, and update date; obtain permission before redistributing protected material.

records.applicability_basis: Québec location, selected chapter, language, and effective date.
exclusions: An English display or translation does not remove the need to identify the official source and applicable language context.
records.notes: The record preserves source identity and update metadata without copying the legal text.

records.title: CSA ISO/IEC TR 15067-3:12 (R2021)
records.scope: Standards catalogue metadata only; applicability and incorporation basis are unresolved in this example.

version.currency_note: Catalogue identifies publication and reaffirmation information.

authority.incorporation_basis: No incorporation evidence recorded; do not treat as mandatory.

rights.permission_note: Catalogue states that the PDF is DRM-protected and subject to CSA copyright terms; no standard text is stored here.

records.source_date_label: publication year and reaffirmation shown by catalogue
records.applicability_basis: Requires a recorded law, contract, certification, or customer requirement before use.
exclusions: Catalogue metadata is not evidence that the standard applies to a manufacturing site or product.
records.notes: This record demonstrates metadata-first handling for a copyrighted standard.

claims.scope: Federal consolidated Acts are available from Justice Laws.
No mandatory application is established from the catalogue record alone.
